te: Original city of Panama (founded in 1519) is destroyed by a fire when privateer Henry Morgan sacks and sets fire to it.…
dz: 巴拿马的原始城市(建于1519年)被私人亨利·摩根麻袋并放火烧毁. 之前被破坏的城市遗址仍然被废墟所覆盖(参见巴拿马维约).
de: Original city of Panama (founded in 1519) is destroyed by a fire when privateer Henry Morgan sacks and sets fire to it. The site of the previously devastated city is still in ruins (see Panama Viejo).

t: 被伪装成神职人员的托马斯·布拉德(Thomas Blood)试图从伦敦塔中盗取英格兰王冠珠宝.
te: Thomas Blood, disguised as a clergyman, attempts to steal England's Crown Jewels from the Tower of London.
dz: 被伪装成神职人员的托马斯·布拉德(Thomas Blood)试图从伦敦塔中盗取英格兰王冠珠宝.
de: Thomas Blood, disguised as a clergyman, attempts to steal England's Crown Jewels from the Tower of London.
